(Japanese: 裏切りと復讐と… Betrayal and Revenge and...) is the 66th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Yappy is offered a chance to become famous by Gerubu, but violently declines and runs away.
Gerubu tags Yappy with a tracker.
Hariru and Carola plans their revenge on Fraud, only to find the GG headquarters destroyed by him.
Hariru and Fraud's battle begins.
